summary: 3DNow! 2-component vector normalize (__stdcall). Squares the input packed pair a2[0] lane-wise (pfmul), horizontally accumulates the two lanes with pfacc to produce the packed squared length, takes a packed reciprocal square root with pfrsqrt, refines it with a Newton-Raphson step (pfrsqit1 + pfrcpit2), masks the input against a near-zero guard produced by pfcmpgt against the threshold constant qword_5AF970 (0x80000000800000), and stores a1[0] = pfmul(pand(input, mask), refined_rsqrt) so degenerate/zero-length vectors are nulled. Emits _m_femms() before return and returns a1. Existing analysis (skeletons_filled/sub_526E7B_00526e7b.md) names it F_3DNowVector2Normalize; the threshold global binding follows that same analysis (DERIVED).

operations.description: Compute the per-lane square v2 = pfmul(a2[0], a2[0]).
Horizontally accumulate both lanes v4 = pfacc(v2, v2), giving the packed squared length of the 2-component vector.
Take the packed reciprocal square root v5 = pfrsqrt(v4).

Build the degenerate-length mask with pfcmpgt(v4, 0x80000000800000): lanes where the squared length exceeds the near-zero threshold keep the input; smaller/zero lengths are masked out. The threshold constant is bound to global qword_5AF970 per the sibling normalize analysis (sub_527578).
Refine the reciprocal square root with a Newton-Raphson step: pfrcpit2(pfrsqit1(pfmul(v5, v5), v4), v5).
Store the normalized vector: a1[0] = pfmul(pand(a2[0], mask), refined_rsqrt), i.e. input masked by the length guard times the refined reciprocal root.
Emit _m_femms() to exit MMX/3DNow state before returning.
Return the output buffer pointer a1.

unresolved: The binding of the inline threshold literal 0x80000000800000 to global qword_5AF970 is inherited from the existing analysis (DERIVED), not stated in the raw source.
The packed lane order of the two components (x,y) within a2[0] is not recoverable from this function alone.
Owner is UNKNOWN; the packet carries no owner evidence and no static callers/callees.
